Pepper's Paris Surprise

A Puppy's Discovery of Paris, Museums and Historic Wonders — Sneak Peek Preview

Off the plane and blinking under bright terminal lights, Pepper spotted a familiar wagging tail through the crowd. “Bienvenue à Paris, cousin!” Nose bumped nose. “Now the real adventure starts.”

Pop Corn pointed a paw straight up. “Regarde!” Pepper tilted back... and back... and back. “Do French dogs get dizzy?” Pop Corn shrugged. “Only tourists.”

A whole wall of croissants! Pepper's nose short-circuited. Pop Corn ordered like a regular — and the baker slipped them TWO.

They stepped inside — and gasped. Every wall was glowing stained glass. “I feel like we're standing inside a jewel,” Pepper breathed.

The whole glowing city floated by. Pop Corn leaned out for the spray — “Best seat in Paris.” Pepper leaned out too, and got a face full of river.

Fountains sprayed rainbows across gardens that stretched forever. “Told you I saved the best for last,” Pop Corn said. Pepper had to agree.

25 more wonders are waiting inside — from a Paris Métro mishap to a moonlit night at Sacré-Cœur, and a very stylish stroll past Shakespeare and Company!
